name: dim0-jazz
description: Read and edit shared Dim0 canvas boards using board-scoped OAuth and Jazz.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate on your shared canvas with AI
interface.longDescription: Connect an assistant to one Dim0 board you explicitly authorize. Read canvas cards and links, create and rename cards, update applet code and shared state, and collaborate with people while preserving Jazz role permissions and version history. Each person signs into their own Dim0 account to approve a board; ChatGPT tool calls act as that person.
capabilities: Create, rename and update cards and links
Read or update shared applet state
Respect editor/viewer roles and optimistic versions
defaultPrompt: List the cards on my authorized Dim0 board.
Create a canvas card titled Sprint checklist on my board.
Rename the selected board card after checking its version.
Show and update the shared counter applet state.

positive.prompt: List the cards in my connected Dim0 board.
positive.expected_behavior: Only lists the board approved for this OAuth connection and its readable canvas entities.

positive.prompt: Create a board card titled Sprint checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one versioned canvas node in the authorized board and returns its ID.

positive.prompt: Rename the Sprint checklist card to Sprint complete.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads full payload and current version, edits only the intended title, preserves the entity ID and other fields, and reports the new version.

positive.prompt: What is the current shared counter value?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the authorized applet state and its version, without modifying it.

negative.description: Another board is not automatically in scope
negative.prompt: Read a different Dim0 board I did not approve.
Delete a card when I only have viewer access.
Overwrite a stale card version without checking its latest state.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Private preview: OAuth-bound Dim0 canvas and shared applet operations.
